records.text: A friend of Cooper Brown told Owens that Brown did not want to speak to the media because he had been instructed not to after previously getting a Turning Point chapter in trouble for speaking publicly.
records.speaker: Anonymous Source #17 (Ep pc3pxRyNFZk)

appearances.snippet: Kind of then messages me privately because I reached out, and I'm like, "I'm just trying to confirm the story." And I reached out, and he says to me—well, and I'm paraphrasing here—he doesn't want to speak to you. He doesn't want to speak to media because he's been instructed not to speak to media because he's gotten the Turning Point chapter into trouble before for speaking out in the media. And he just doesn't want to do that.
